items.text: The Patriots are concerned that QB Drake Maye fractured his ankle, per sources. Maye remained in Germany to undergo additional testing to determine whether he needs surgery. Either way, he is out indefinitely, if not for the season.
items.priorStatus: Significant lower leg injury, possible rest of season
items.newStatus: Fractured ankle, out indefinitely if not for the season
items.why: Schefter reports Patriots concerned Maye fractured his ankle; remained in Germany for more testing on surgery need. Rapoport confirms fractured ankle.
items.implication: NE offense long-term without Maye; backup QB and potential RB role changes elevate Corey Kiner opportunity.
items.opportunity: Stronger case for Corey Kiner waiver claim if confirmed extended absence; monitor NE backfield usage.
corroboration: Ian Rapoport (@RapSheet): More details on Drake Maye... A fractured ankle necessitating the stay in Germany.
